meta.title: 끝없는 확대
meta.reviewed: Written by hand from source/BRIEF.md (끝없는 확대, a science-museum exhibition that dives from a ginkgo leaf down to one magnesium atom (fictional exhibition)). Every decision below follows the brief and the style it names; nothing is a preset.

source.notes: 끝없는 확대, a science-museum exhibition that dives from a ginkgo leaf down to one magnesium atom (fictional exhibition)
Korean OFL fonts, cut to the characters the reel shows

rationale.palette: Each step brings its own world: walnut and leaf green, the pale greens of cells and chloroplasts, the pink and gold of lipid membranes, navy for the molecule and black for the atom with a blue and violet electron cloud; type and HUD in white over a dark band.
rationale.type: Hahmlet, a modern serif with sharp contrast, for names and lines; IBM Plex Sans KR for the readout and the scale.
rationale.motion: One continuous logarithmic zoom into the centre of the screen: ten times closer every four beats in the 30-second cut and every beat in the 15-second dive; the next world first shows as a small framed picture labelled with its size and grows until it covers the screen; at the end the camera rushes back out through all ten steps in a beat and a half.
rationale.sound: Ambient at 96 BPM in D lydian: a soft pad, sub and shaker, and a recorded glockenspiel (VSCO 2 CE, CC0) that climbs the lydian scale one note per tenfold step; a whoosh for the rush back out and a tubular bell when the table returns.
rationale.visuals: All code: eleven layers drawn in their own units, each one ten times smaller than the last, nested so the camera target is always the centre; the leaf and its veins are the same drawing at both 10 cm and 1 cm; cells, a stoma, chloroplasts, grana, a membrane with proteins, a light-harvesting trimer, a ball-and-stick chlorophyll and a stippled electron cloud.
rationale.narration: Not recommended: the readout says where we are.
